name: Epigenetics Scout
tagline: A weekly readable digest of new partial-reprogramming research, findings split from hype
description: Once a week it reads the new partial-reprogramming papers on PubMed and bioRxiv plus lab pages and turns them into a plain-words digest. Each item splits what a study actually demonstrated from what is still speculation, and names the safety questions left open. It stops at the literature: no do-it-yourself protocols.
author: AdeptusMec71933
